The desk combines AI signals with manual control. Newcomers can start on the practice account, fund US$250 when ready, and trade 8 assets through the partner broker.
Our method is a desk review: no funded account, no trades. We read the published material in full, including unfilled placeholders and contradictions, and scored five fixed dimensions.
whatItClaims: 8 crypto assets through broker partners.
A free demo account with practice funds.
Around-the-clock support through the partner desk.
Signals generated without manual chart reading.
A US$250 minimum deposit to start.
whatWeChecked: The security claims: encryption and account protection statements.
The withdrawal path: steps and any fees the page omits.
The ownership trail: who operates the platform and where.
The support channels: live chat, email or phone availability.
The fine print: clauses that qualify the headline promises.
The fee framing: no platform fees, but spreads embedded in every trade.

pros: Fast setup - minutes to a live dashboard.
Free registration and a demo account.
cons: No verified track record.
One figure doing two different jobs.
Return claims without verification.
Payout wording without processing detail.

Template placeholders left unrendered.
Return claims without verification.
The fee that is not a fee: spreads embedded in every trade.
Contradictions across core facts: fees, support and restrictions all disagree.

faqs.a: Yes - signup is free and activates through a confirmation link. The first cost is the US$250 deposit, which stays in your trading balance.
The page promises payouts within a day, but the processing detail is thin. Confirm the exact timeline and any fees with support before funding anything.
US$250, funded by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill. It is trading capital in your balance, not a fee - and it is exposed to market risk once live.
Yes - the platform offers automatic and manual modes, so you can follow the signals or confirm each entry yourself.
The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.

bottomLine: As a product, Falcon Wertgrove offers the expected setup and nothing that breaks. The issues sit in the published claims, and the claims are avoidable if you trade the minimum.
4.5 is our number, and it means the product works with conditions attached. The demo costs nothing; use it while the claims remain unproven.
This is our first-line CAUTION: the pages raise more questions about fees, ownership and restrictions than they answer.
